title: Negotiate before closing the Unix-socket adapter in gmcp_req_203_012_06_operations
goal: gmcp_req_203_012_06_operations, landed after T-CLAUDECLOUDREL-3, repeats the Unix-only mistake that task fixed in three older tests: it probes server/discover on a Unix-domain socket and closes it without the initialize handshake, then requires the session to end as Closed, so it fails on Linux with 'unix socket: negotiation failed: ConnectionClosed("initialize request")' and failed the v0.21.68 tests gate on main ba2d2c43d. Add the handshake and re-record the VC-203 requirement and mastery evidence on the committed tree (CEO direction 2026-11-15: fix the gmcp tests and cut the core release).
limitations: Verified on Linux x86_64 only; the changed lines are inside a cfg(unix) block and do not compile on Windows.
A new GMCP test that copies the socket probe without the handshake will fail on Linux again; the branch never runs on the Windows hosts where these tests are written.
